convergence.exportEnvironment: linux-x64, node 22.14; fontconfig on the export host set to hintstyle=hintnone/antialias=true/rgba=none with the repo TTFs installed as system fonts - pen 0.3.5's rasterizer follows host fontconfig, so the recorded exportSha256 values are reproducible under this config. DETERMINISM CAVEAT FOR THE LAB: the pinned GC lab is macOS arm64; if its re-export hashes differ, suspect platform rasterization drift (fontconfig/FreeType vs CoreText), not authoring drift - the .pen bytes are the locked identity and contentHash is platform-independent.
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-baseline knob, not this loop's - v002 interpretation carried). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, contract root #dcHost section.dc, Playwright 1.62.1 Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (the lab's pinned Chromium version), deviceScaleFactor 2 (matches pen export scale 2), Google Fonts blocked, Heebo + Noto Serif served via fontconfig from pencil/designs/fonts (the same TTFs the .pen references), unhinted rendering (hintnone - matches pen's design-metric advances), fonts.ready awaited, animations disabled at screenshot, states driven via the states.json steps (synthetic PointerEvent dispatch per the contract), capture-context pixel-grid snap (sub-pixel position:relative top/left nudge so 1px borders rasterize on the same device grid in both renderers), 15/15 states rendered with zero page errors.
convergence.iterationNotes: Iteration 1 (authoring from extracted normalized-prototype scene graphs; text placed from TTF hhea metrics at lineHeight 1, baselines measured from Chromium's own canvas fontBoundingBox metrics) landed 13/15 under budget (0.4-0.9%), config-error 4.7%. Iteration 2 applied empirically measured per-class baseline tunes (svg-center +1.0 css, svg-card +0.5, legend +0.5, error +1.0, title 0 - pen 0.3.5 quantizes text baselines to integer css positions, calibration-probe verified). Iteration 3 probed letterSpacing compensation for config-error's accumulated advance drift (helped, insufficient). Iteration 4: root cause isolated to HINTED Chromium advances vs pen's unhinted design-metric advances - render context switched to fontconfig hintnone (affects both renderers on this host, target AND export), letterSpacing hack removed; every state improved 3-4x (most 0.03-0.18%), config-error 1.5%. Iteration 5: capture-context pixel-grid snap (the template layout leaves section.dc at a fractional y; Chromium snaps 1px borders to the css grid pre-transform, so the nudge is a real layout offset, not a transform) - config-error 0.893%, 15/15 PASS, no waivers. Infra corrections between iterations (Playwright 1.49->1.62 / Chromium 131->151 to match the lab, pixel-exact clip) did not consume authoring iterations.
